title: APF the Lick Observatory Automated Planet Finder
what_was_studied: Automated telescope, Levy spectrograph, iodine-cell method and first-light tests
numerical_result: Coverage is 374 to 970 nm; resolving power reaches 150000; selected standards showed sub-m/s RMS over three months
remaining_question: First-light standards do not establish the distribution achieved across later survey targets

title: Capabilities and performance of the Automated Planet Finder Telescope with a dynamic scheduler
what_was_studied: Six hundred observing hours, scheduling efficiency and RV performance
numerical_result: For 4954 velocities of 80 stars the median internal uncertainty was 1.35 m/s
remaining_question: Internal uncertainty and stable-star RMS must remain separate quantities

title: The Automated Planet Finder telescope automation and first three years of planet detections
what_was_studied: Early operations, stability, scheduling and science use
numerical_result: Bright RV standards reached about 1 m/s internal precision in the reported analysis
remaining_question: The thesis-era reduction and iodine-cell configuration need mapping to later products

title: Automated Planet Finder
what_was_studied: Current facility description and access point for APF
numerical_result: The page identifies the 2.4 m automated telescope and Levy spectrograph but gives no dated performance validation
